form set_pfstatus_qa_zworklist                              "#EC CALLED
     using
         pt_requests         type tmsiqreqs
     changing
         pv_header           type stmsiqtop.


data: lv_lines     type i.
data: lv_lines_req type i.
data: lv_lines_pro type i.

data: lv_cnt(10)   type c.
data: lv_text(50)  type c.

data: lt_systems             type TCECONFIRMS.
data: lt_exclude             type stms_pf_excl   occurs 0.
data: ls_exclude             type stms_pf_excl.
*data: lv_step_choosed        type stms_flag.
*data: lv_client_choosed      type stms_flag.
data: lv_ctc    like tmspconf-value.
data: lv_system like tmscsys-sysnam.


    refresh lt_exclude.
    clear ls_exclude.

    if gv_show_pushbutton_save <> gc_qa_x.
        move 'VERT' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "QA-Status verteilen
        append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
    endif.
    if gv_qastep = gc_qa_no_special_step.
*        move 'QAOK' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. genehmigen
*        append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
*        move 'QAVB' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. ablehnen
*        append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
    else.
        move 'DFBU_WL' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. löschen
        append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
    endif.

*
    describe table gt_projects lines lv_lines_pro.
    if lv_lines_pro = 0.
        move 'SHPI' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Projektbeschreibung
        append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
    endif.

* get informations
    call function 'TMS_QAM_GET_QA_SYSTEMS'
*   call function 'TR_TCE_GET_SYST_TO_QA_CONFIRM'
         exporting
              iv_sysname                 = gv_system
         importing
              et_confirms                = lt_systems
         exceptions
              tce_no_configuration_found = 1
              others                     = 2.

    if sy-subrc <> 0.
        message id sy-msgid type sy-msgty number sy-msgno
                with sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
        raising worklist_display_failed.
    endif.
    describe table lt_systems LINES lv_lines.
    if lv_lines < 2.
        move 'OQUE_WL' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Anderer Arb.vorrat
        append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
    endif.

*---top-of-page Kopfsatz mit Datum/Uhrzeit
    perform top_of_page_wl_header
            tables lt_systems.       "standard top-of-page (Kopfsatz)
    describe table pt_requests lines gs_header-count1.         "1.6.99
    lv_text = gs_header-cntinf.                                "1.6.99
    write gs_header-count1 to lv_cnt no-zero.                  "1.6.99
    replace '&1' with lv_cnt into lv_text.                     "1.6.99
    write gs_header-count2 to lv_cnt no-zero.                  "1.6.99
    replace '&2' with lv_cnt into lv_text.                     "1.6.99
    condense lv_text.                                          "1.6.99
    gs_header-cntinf = lv_text.                                "1.6.99
    pv_header = gs_header.


* messages 'please choose... '
*---not to proceed if worklist is empty
    describe table gt_requests lines lv_lines_req.
    if lv_lines_req > 0.
*-------get ctc
        lv_system = gv_system.
        call function 'TMS_PM_READ_TP_PARAMETER'
             exporting
                  iv_parameter             = 'CTC'
                  iv_system                = lv_system
                  iv_verbose               = space
                  iv_monitor               = ' '
             importing
                  ev_value                 = lv_ctc
             exceptions
                  others                   = 0.
*                 read_tp_parameter_failed = 1
*                 parameter_not_found      = 2
*                 others                   = 3.
*       if  sy-subrc <> 0. endif.


        clear: gv_step_choosed,
               gv_client_choosed.

* is there more than one QA client
        if lv_ctc = gc_tms_pm_val_1.
            if lv_lines = 1.
                gv_client_choosed = gc_qa_x.
            else.
* if there is only one client in the queue it is not neccessary
* to choose one
*                read table gt_requests into gs_request index 1.
*                if sy-subrc = 0.
*                    loop at gt_requests into gs_request
*                         where tarcli <> gs_request-tarcli.
*                         exit.
*                    endloop.
*                    if sy-subrc <> 0.
*                        gv_client_choosed = gc_qa_x.
*                    endif.
*                endif.
            endif.
         endif.

*-------if ctc = 0 -> client is not to choose
        if lv_ctc = gc_tms_pm_val_0.
            gv_client_choosed = gc_qa_x.
        endif.
*-------step is choosed
        if  gv_qastep <> gc_qa_no_special_step
        and gv_qastep <> space.                    "10.01.2002
            gv_step_choosed = gc_qa_x.
        endif.
*-------filter 'target client' is choosed
        loop at gt_filter into gs_filter.
            if gs_filter-FIELD  = 'TARCLI'.
                gv_client_choosed = gc_qa_x.
                exit.
            endif.
        endloop.
*-------send message, exclude function 'Auftrag löschen' from the menu
        if gv_step_choosed = space.
            if gv_client_choosed = space.
*               move 'QAOK' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. genehmigen
*               append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
*               move 'QAVB' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. ablehnen
*               append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
                move 'DFBU_WL' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. löschen
                append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
                message s043(qact).                 "Mand.+Schritt ausw.
            else.
                message s042(qact).                 "Schritt ausw.
            endif.
        else.
            if gv_client_choosed = space.
*               move 'QAOK' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. genehmigen
*               append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
*               move 'QAVB' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. ablehnen
*               append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
                move 'DFBU_WL' to ls_exclude-fcode.    "Auftr. löschen
                append ls_exclude to lt_exclude.
                message i044(qact).                 "Mandt. ausw.
            endif.
        endif.
    endif.

    "{ Inicio SGR 27.03.2025 | Solo permitir la aprobacion y la negacion de las OT
    append value #( fcode = 'REFR_WL' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SOUP' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SODO' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'DIS+' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'DIS-' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'FILT' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'FILT_SAVE' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'REMK' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'BLMK' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'ALMK' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'UNMK' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SHTA' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SHNA' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SHUS' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SHDO' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'SHPR' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'CHGS' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'VERT' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'QAST' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'TRAC' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'UCFG_WL' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'LEGE_WL' ) to lt_exclude.
    append value #( fcode = 'INFO_WL' ) to lt_exclude.
    "{ Fin SGR 27.03.2025 | Solo permitir la aprobacion y la negacion de las OT

* set pf status and titlebar
    set pf-status 'WORKLIST' excluding lt_exclude.
    set titlebar 'WORKLIST' with  gv_system.

* set counter of list entries for list header info             "1.6.99
*   describe table pt_requests lines lv_lines.                 "1.6.99
*   pv_header-count1 = lv_lines.                               "1.6.99

* define the texts if errors occured
    pv_header-ALERTID = gv_exception_id.
    pv_header-ERRTXT  = text-130.
    pv_header-EMPTXT  = text-131.

endform.
